description: Calculate a conservative return-by date from the last day in country under the supported Panama and Paraguay residency-maintenance rules. The calculation uses the day before the calendar anniversary. It is limited to the listed residency types; it does not calculate presence for other countries or citizenship.

as_of.description: Optional date for the countdown, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

departure_date.description: Last day in the country, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: calculate_residency_return
title: Calculate residency return date
